units.source: Backlinks
A link points from one note to another; a __TRILIUM_PH_0__backlink__TRILIUM_PH_1__ is that same connection seen from the other end: the list of notes that refer to the current one.
Backlinks are maintained automatically and are read-only from this side. A backlink disappears when the note that created it removes the link; it cannot be deleted from the note being pointed at.
What counts as a backlink__TRILIUM_PH_0__

units.source: Any __TRILIUM_PH_0__Internal (reference) links__TRILIUM_PH_1__ pointing at the current note, which covers two rather different cases:

units.source: Relations that Trilium maintains on your behalf.
units.context: Backlinks > What counts as a backlink

units.source: The most common is __TRILIUM_PH_0__, created whenever a note refers to another one through __TRILIUM_PH_1__Internal (reference) links__TRILIUM_PH_2__ in its text.
units.context: Backlinks > What counts as a backlink

units.source: Embedded images (__TRILIUM_PH_0__), relation map connections (__TRILIUM_PH_1__) and note inclusions (__TRILIUM_PH_2__) work the same way.
units.context: Backlinks > What counts as a backlink

units.source: Relations you define yourself.
units.context: Backlinks > What counts as a backlink

units.source: If another note has __TRILIUM_PH_0__ pointing at the current note, that note is listed here as well.
units.context: Backlinks > What counts as a backlink

units.source: Relations coming from a __TRILIUM_PH_0__Saved Search__TRILIUM_PH_1__ are excluded, since a search stores an __TRILIUM_PH_2__ relation that would otherwise list every one of its results as a backlink.
units.context: Backlinks > What counts as a backlink

units.source: Only some note types have their content scanned for links: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Text__TRILIUM_PH_1__, __TRILIUM_PH_2__Markdown__TRILIUM_PH_3__, __TRILIUM_PH_4__Relation Map__TRILIUM_PH_5__ and __TRILIUM_PH_6__AI__TRILIUM_PH_7__ chats. A link written inside a __TRILIUM_PH_8__Code__TRILIUM_PH_9__ note is not registered and will not appear as a backlink on the target note. A relation set manually on a code note does still count.
units.context: Backlinks > What counts as a backlink

units.source: How entries are displayed__TRILIUM_PH_0__
Each entry names the note the reference comes from, followed by one of:

__TRILIUM_PH_0__An excerpt__TRILIUM_PH_1__ of the surrounding content, with the link itself highlighted. This is available for __TRILIUM_PH_2__Text__TRILIUM_PH_3__ notes and for __TRILIUM_PH_4__AI__TRILIUM_PH_5__ chat notes. Roughly 200 characters of context are quoted around the link, trimmed with an ellipsis where the surrounding text is longer, and images are left out.

__TRILIUM_PH_0__The name of the relation__TRILIUM_PH_1__, for every other note type where the source cannot be quoted. This is the case for __TRILIUM_PH_2__Relation Map__TRILIUM_PH_3__ notes and for any note carrying a relation you defined yourself.
A note is listed once per reference it makes, so a note that links to the current one three times occupies three rows.
Of note:
For AI chat notes, only the assistant's own prose is quoted. A chat that reached the note purely through tool calls has nothing to quote and is listed by relation name instead.
Excerpts are only generated for roughly the first 50 sources. On a heavily referenced note, the remaining entries fall back to showing the relation name.
Where backlinks are shown__TRILIUM_PH_0__
In the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Connections tab__TRILIUM_PH_1__ of the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Right Sidebar__TRILIUM_PH_3__, as a dedicated section.

As a badge in the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Status bar__TRILIUM_PH_1__ showing the number of backlinks. The badge only appears when the note is being read normally (not in a revision or attachment view) and when there is at least one backlink; pressing it opens the section above.

In __TRILIUM_PH_0__Quick edit__TRILIUM_PH_1__, as a button with a link icon in the header of the popup, under the same conditions; its tooltip gives the number of backlinks. Pressing a backlink opens that note in the popup.
Incoming links are also drawn on the link map, see __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note Map (Link map, Tree map)__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
